xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3357: Deacon stale-state purge deleted conv-* transcript dirs — 258 conversations shown as 'Transcript missing'

plan.title: Deacon stale-state purge deleted conv-* transcript dirs — 258 conversations shown as 'Transcript missing'
plan.author: agent:k3[1m]

metadata.sizeJustification: One inseparable hardening change against a single data-loss incident: the deletion door (WI-1) is meaningless without the call-site routing (WI-2) and CI guard (WI-3), and the sweep config (WI-4), migration command (WI-5), and docs (WI-6) all document or consume the same invariant. The 8-subsystem count is an artifact of cross-cutting fixes spanning cloister/lib/cli/scripts/docs with two files each; no slice ships standalone value without the door.

narratives.Problem: The deacon retention purge deleted conv-* agent dirs — the only home of codex/ohmypi conversation transcripts — surfacing as 'Transcript missing' for 258 conversations. The immediate conv-* guard already landed (7952eb6a67), but work/review/planning agent transcripts inside agent dirs are still deleted by four other paths (retention purge, pre-fresh-spawn wipes, close-out/deep-wipe teardown, orphan sweep), with no shared invariant across five scattered deletion call sites.
narratives.Proposal: Introduce a single deletion door (removeAgentStateDir in src/lib/agents/state-dir-removal.ts) that deletes runtime residue but preserves every **/*.jsonl transcript artifact in place; route all five deletion sites through it; add a CI guard script that fails lint on any new direct rm of an AGENTS_DIR path outside the door; add opt-in retention.transcript_days config with a dedicated deacon sweep (unset = retain forever, sweep never registered); add a one-time idempotent `pan admin migrate-legacy-agent-dirs` command for other machines; correct stale 'Phase 6' docstrings and document the retention model.
narratives.NonGoals:
- A --purge-transcripts escape hatch for deep-wipe (explicitly rejected; deep-wipe preserves transcripts)
- Per-harness transcript allowlists (**/*.jsonl is the single preservation predicate)
- Fixing the codex newest-rollout fallback window after fresh spawn (pre-existing, PAN-1690)
- Restoring the 258 already-purged dirs from restic (done by hand on the primary machine; FR-5's command covers other machines)
- Changing claude-code or kimi-code transcript locations (their transcripts never lived in agent dirs)
- Re-implementing the conv-* retention-purge guard (landed in 7952eb6a67)

autoDecisions.summary: Adopted the canonical PRD on overdeck-state (drafts/pan-3357.md, written by the investigating conversation) as the workspace PRD draft after re-verifying every file/line reference against this workspace.
autoDecisions.rationale: The PRD-first gate requires a workspace draft, the canonical PRD is accurate and current (2026-07-31), and rewriting it would risk drift; the only refinement made was naming the verified conversations read door (getConversationByName in src/lib/database/conversations-db.ts:212) for the WI-4 sweep.

autoDecisions.summary: Kept the PRD's six work items as six xBRIEF items 1:1 rather than decomposing further.
autoDecisions.rationale: Each work item is already a small, independently reviewable vertical slice with its own named tests; the five deletion-site routes in WI-2 are mechanically identical swaps the task-granularity rules allow as one task.

autoDecisions.summary: Set requiresInspection: true only on the deletion-door module item.
autoDecisions.rationale: The door is the foundation two downstream items call directly (route-deletion-sites) or allowlist against (guard-agent-dir-removal); every other item is mechanical or a leaf whose failure surfaces at typecheck/lint/test.

items.title: Create removeAgentStateDir deletion door in src/lib/agents/state-dir-removal.ts

expected_outputs: the four named tests in state-dir-removal.test.ts pass

narrative.Action: Create the single deletion door per PRD WI-1: an async (fs/promises only) removeAgentStateDir(dirPath) that recursively walks an agent dir, deletes every non-.jsonl file, preserves every **/*.jsonl in place, post-order prunes directories left empty, and returns { removedFiles, preservedTranscripts, removedDir }. A missing dirPath is a no-op success (removedDir: true, zero counts) to preserve callers' force:true semantics. If no .jsonl exists anywhere in the tree, remove the directory entirely (equivalent to the old rm -rf). Write src/lib/agents/__tests__/state-dir-removal.test.ts with mkdtempSync temp dirs and exactly these four test names: 'removes a dir with no jsonl entirely', 'preserves codex-home/sessions rollouts and deletes runtime residue', 'preserves root-level per-run jsonl (PAN-1908 pi layout)', 'is idempotent on an already-pruned dir'. Do NOT add this to deacon.ts or agent-state.ts (file-size ratchet, NFR-3).

items.title: Given a temp agent dir with no .jsonl files, when removeAgentStateDir runs, then it deletes the directory entirely and returns removedDir: true
Given a temp agent dir with codex-home/sessions rollouts plus state.json/session.id residue, when the door runs, then it preserves every .jsonl in place and deletes the residue files
Given a root-level per-run .jsonl (PAN-1908 pi layout), when the door runs, then it preserves the root .jsonl and removes empty subdirectories that held only residue
When removeAgentStateDir runs a second time on an already-pruned dir, then it succeeds idempotently and preserves the same transcript files

If deacon.ts grows past its allowlisted line count, bump the existing '# PAN-3357' row in scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt in the same commit. Add CI guard script failing lint on direct AGENTS_DIR deletions outside the door

narrative.Action: Per PRD WI-3: create scripts/guard-agent-dir-removal.sh by copying the structure and allowlist style of scripts/guard-workspace-doors.sh. The guard greps src/ for rm/rmSync/rmdir calls whose argument expression references AGENTS_DIR or getAgentDir outside src/lib/agents/state-dir-removal.ts. Inline allowlist: review-convoy.ts marker-file deletions, lifecycle-restart.ts:728,731 (single-file session.id/sessions.json removals), termination.ts:175,237 (git-guard/ removal), and test files; every allowlisted site must carry a '// PAN-3357: not a dir removal' comment the guard checks for (add the comment to lifecycle-restart.ts and termination.ts sites as part of this item if missing). Wire the script into the npm run lint chain in package.json next to guard-workspace-doors.sh. Do not add fixture-based negative tests unless guard-workspace-doors.sh has one.

Add opt-in retention.transcript_days config and deacon transcript sweep

expected_outputs: the three named transcript-retention tests pass

narrative.Action: Per PRD WI-4: add transcript_days?: number to the retention config interface (~src/lib/cloister/config.ts:305 block) with NO entry in DEFAULT_CLOISTER_CONFIG — unset means retain forever and the sweep is never registered. Docstring intent: 'Days to keep transcript artifacts (**/*.jsonl) inside ended agents' state dirs. UNSET (default) = retain forever; the sweep does not run. This is the only mechanism that may delete transcript artifacts.' Create src/lib/cloister/transcript-retention.ts implementing the sweep with fs/promises only: only runs when transcript_days is a positive number; iterates agent dirs; skips any with a live tmux session (sessionExists); for conv-* dirs additionally requires the conversation row status 'ended' or archived_at set, read via getConversationByName from src/lib/database/conversations-db.ts (inject this dependency for testability — never raw SQLite); deletes .jsonl files with mtime older than N days; prunes empty dirs; logs one summary action line. Wire it into the deacon patrol next to the shouldRunRecoveryJanitor('agent-state', ...) block (~deacon.ts:3119), registered only when configured. Write src/lib/cloister/__tests__/transcript-retention.test.ts with mkdtempSync temp dirs and vi.useFakeTimers (never real waits) using exactly these three test names: 'does not run when transcript_days is unset' (assert no fs traversal via mocked readdir), 'deletes only jsonl older than N days for ended agents', 'never touches dirs with a live tmux session'.

items.title: When transcript_days is unset, the sweep does not run and no fs traversal occurs (asserted via mocked readdir)
Given transcript_days = N and an ended agent dir, when the sweep runs, then it deletes only .jsonl files with mtime older than N days and preserves newer ones
Given a dir with a live tmux session, when the sweep runs, then it never touches that dir's files
DEFAULT_CLOISTER_CONFIG contains no transcript_days entry, so the config defaults to retain-forever
Add pan admin migrate-legacy-agent-dirs command for pre-rebrand conv-* dirs

expected_outputs: typecheck and lint complete without errors

narrative.Action: Per PRD WI-5: create src/cli/commands/admin/migrate-legacy-agent-dirs.ts following the structure of src/cli/commands/admin/state-migrate.ts, registered under pan admin. Behavior: for each conv-* dir in ~/.panopticon/agents/ (literal legacy path — predates OVERDECK_HOME), if ~/.overdeck/agents/<name> does not exist, copy recursively preserving mtimes (never move, never overwrite, never modify the legacy side); print 'copied N, skipped M'; exit 0 when the legacy dir is absent. Structure the core copy logic to accept both home paths as parameters so tests inject temp dirs. This verb gets NO wrapper skill — add it to the exclusion list in docs/SKILLS-CONVENTION.md if scripts/lint-skills.sh requires it. Test file location may follow existing admin-command test conventions (files_scope_confidence medium for that reason): unit test with two mkdtempSync temp dirs standing in for legacy and current homes, asserting copy-once idempotence.

When the command runs a second time, then it prints 'copied 0' and exits 0 without overwriting anything
When the legacy ~/.panopticon/agents dir is absent, the command exits 0 as a no-op
